name: Tran
source:
The daughter of the High Priest of Mineria in the northern country, Tran has been placed in the confidence of the archduchess Prisila.
To Ryu, she is something akin to an older sister that he can trust.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071028072348/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dragonia/pop_cha03.html]official site[/url]]
